newsitem.title: UK: Exxon to expand Scottish ethylene plant.
newsitem.headline: Exxon to expand Scottish ethylene plant.

text.p: Exxon Chemical Co, part of Exxon Corp, said it would debottleneck its ethylene production plant at Mossmorran, Scotland, raising capacity to some 800,000 tonnes a year, or 60 percent above startup capacity in 1985.
It said the managing contract for the project had been awarded to AMEC Process and Energy, part of the AMEC International Group.
Exxon Chemical said project engineering and materials procurement would continue through 1996 and building should be finished in the summer of 1998.

"This expansion will help meet the needs of a growing ethylene market in Europe, at significantly less cost than grassroots cost," said Sherman Glass, vice president of Basic Chemicals for Exxon Chemical Europe.
